SELECT CAST(16 AS INT64) AS dk_player_id, CAST(2026 AS INT64) AS season, CAST(NULL AS INT64) AS week, TIMESTAMP('2026-09-21 00:20:00+00') AS game_start, 'LAR' AS team_abbr, TIMESTAMP('2026-09-12 16:00:00+00') AS pulled_at, 'classic' AS slate_type, CAST(5000 AS INT64) AS salary, 'None' AS status, CAST(10.0 AS FLOAT64) AS dk_ppg, 'Fixture 16' AS display_name, 'WR' AS position
),
map_fixture AS (
SELECT CAST(1 AS INT64) AS dk_player_id, 'fixture-1' AS gsis_id
UNION ALL
SELECT CAST(2 AS INT64) AS dk_player_id, 'fixture-2' AS gsis_id
UNION ALL
SELECT CAST(3 AS INT64) AS dk_player_id, 'fixture-3' AS gsis_id
UNION ALL
SELECT CAST(4 AS INT64) AS dk_player_id, 'fixture-4' AS gsis_id
UNION ALL

UNION ALL
SELECT CAST(6 AS INT64) AS dk_player_id, 'fixture-6' AS gsis_id
UNION ALL
SELECT CAST(7 AS INT64) AS dk_player_id, 'fixture-7' AS gsis_id
UNION ALL
SELECT CAST(8 AS INT64) AS dk_player_id, 'fixture-8' AS gsis_id
UNION ALL
SELECT CAST(9 AS INT64) AS dk_player_id, 'fixture-9' AS gsis_id
UNION ALL
SELECT CAST(10 AS INT64) AS dk_player_id, 'fixture-10' AS gsis_id
UNION ALL
SELECT CAST(11 AS INT64) AS dk_player_id, 'fixture-11' AS gsis_id
UNION ALL
SELECT CAST(12 AS INT64) AS dk_player_id, 'fixture-12' AS gsis_id
UNION ALL
SELECT CAST(13 AS INT64) AS dk_player_id, 'fixture-13' AS gsis_id
UNION ALL
SELECT CAST(14 AS INT64) AS dk_player_id, 'fixture-14' AS gsis_id
UNION ALL
SELECT CAST(15 AS INT64) AS dk_player_id, 'fixture-15' AS gsis_id
UNION ALL
SELECT CAST(16 AS INT64) AS dk_player_id, 'fixture-16' AS gsis_id
),
own_schedule_games AS (
  -- dk_job deliberately leaves week NULL. Resolve the player's scheduled
  -- game, not the draft group's first game or the current calendar week.
  -- NFL schedule dates are Eastern dates; a Sunday-night UTC timestamp can
  -- already be Monday. Duplicate copies of one schedule game are harmless.
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(season AS INT64) AS season, CAST(week AS INT64) AS week,
    game_id, SAFE_CAST(gameday AS DATE) AS game_date,
    CASE UPPER(team)
      WHEN 'ARZ' THEN 'ARI' WHEN 'BLT' THEN 'BAL' WHEN 'CLV' THEN 'CLE'
      WHEN 'HST' THEN 'HOU' WHEN 'SL' THEN 'LA'
      WHEN 'GNB' THEN 'GB' WHEN 'KAN' THEN 'KC' WHEN 'JAC' THEN 'JAX'
      WHEN 'LAR' THEN 'LA' WHEN 'LVR' THEN 'LV' WHEN 'OAK' THEN 'LV'
      WHEN 'NOR' THEN 'NO' WHEN 'NWE' THEN 'NE' WHEN 'SFO' THEN 'SF'
      WHEN 'TAM' THEN 'TB' WHEN 'SD' THEN 'LAC' WHEN 'SDG' THEN 'LAC'
      WHEN 'STL' THEN 'LA' ELSE UPPER(team)
    END AS team
  FROM schedule_fixture, UNNEST([home_team, away_team]) AS team
  WHERE game_type = 'REG'
),
own_schedule_weeks AS (
  SELECT g.season, g.team, g.game_date, MIN(g.week) AS week
  FROM own_schedule_games g
  WHERE g.game_date IS NOT NULL AND g.game_id IS NOT NULL AND g.week IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY g.season, g.team, g.game_date
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT g.game_id) = 1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT g.week) = 1
),
own_source AS (
  SELECT s.*,
    CASE UPPER(s.team_abbr)
      WHEN 'ARZ' THEN 'ARI' WHEN 'BLT' THEN 'BAL' WHEN 'CLV' THEN 'CLE'
      WHEN 'HST' THEN 'HOU' WHEN 'SL' THEN 'LA'
      WHEN 'GNB' THEN 'GB' WHEN 'KAN' THEN 'KC' WHEN 'JAC' THEN 'JAX'
      WHEN 'LAR' THEN 'LA' WHEN 'LVR' THEN 'LV' WHEN 'OAK' THEN 'LV'
      WHEN 'NOR' THEN 'NO' WHEN 'NWE' THEN 'NE' WHEN 'SFO' THEN 'SF'
      WHEN 'TAM' THEN 'TB' WHEN 'SD' THEN 'LAC' WHEN 'SDG' THEN 'LAC'
      WHEN 'STL' THEN 'LA' ELSE UPPER(s.team_abbr)
    END AS canonical_team
  FROM salary_fixture s
  WHERE s.slate_type = 'classic' AND s.salary > 0
),
own_resolved AS (
  SELECT s.* EXCEPT (week),
    COALESCE(CAST(s.week AS INT64), g.week) AS week
  FROM own_source s
  LEFT JOIN own_schedule_weeks g
    ON s.week IS NULL AND g.season = CAST(s.season AS INT64)
   AND g.team = s.canonical_team
   AND g.game_date = DATE(s.game_start, 'America/New_York')
),
own_log AS (
  SELECT
    m.gsis_id,
    CAST(s.season AS INT64) AS season,
    CAST(s.week AS INT64) AS week,
    s.dk_player_id,
    s.salary,
    s.status,
    s.dk_ppg,
    s.display_name,
    UPPER(s.position) AS position,
    s.canonical_team AS team,
    s.pulled_at,
    1 AS source_priority
  FROM own_resolved s
  JOIN map_fixture m USING (dk_player_id)
  WHERE s.slate_type = 'classic' AND s.week IS NOT NULL AND s.salary > 0
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
    PARTITION BY m.gsis_id, CAST(s.season AS INT64), CAST(s.week AS INT64)
    ORDER BY s.pulled_at DESC, s.dk_player_id
  ) = 1
)
SELECT * FROM own_log
